svg.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
svg.title: mini casino schematic
svg.desc: arduino uno r3 with the 1.3 inch i2c oled, the rc522 rfid reader on spi and 3.3 v, the 4x4 keypad matrix on d3 to d8, a0 and a1, and the passive buzzer with 330 ohm on d2
svg.text: all grounds are common: uno, oled, rc522 and buzzer.
the rc522 runs on 3.3 V only, never on 5 V.
keypad: one row at a time is driven low, the columns
read it through the internal pull-ups. no resistors.
i2c pull-ups sit on the oled module.
d0 and d1 stay free for usb, a2 and a3 are spare.
wire colours are the jumper colours of the build.

g.text: J1: pin 1 = right contact, tail down

svg.text: schematic · uno, oled, rc522, keypad, buzzer
